content: Ndɛb a Yɛsu
Yɛsu kàkäl aŋàyɔl a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl mpal kàfü nde Yɔrdan, Dweelà kun'syen u nsye a ipɔl,
ikal kun'lɛb Satanà ilä an'kwem an'nà. Ilä abin byanswà nde akundiir kàdi anki. Mpal byàwü ilä abi, nde kàwem ngyal.
Satanà kàtɛn a nde naa: « Isàkal naa ngye awà Mwan a Nzam, swaŋ nkɔŋ yi ibulà nsɔ. »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Bàsön naa: "Mbuur usàkal anki anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn nsɔ mpɛl." »
Satanà kun'syen ududu, kun'swɛŋ imfum a mɛɛn byanswà,
waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mɛ in'yapà ikɔ̈b ki kyanswà, un'naaŋ anà làkoo a imfum bi byanswà, ntɔn bya mɛ bàpɛ, mɛ sye in'fàpà akà mbuur wanswà in'kwen mɛ.
Isàkal naa ngye an'bwà an'köm kusà a mɛ, ayi yanswà iyàkal yà ngye. »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Bàsön naa: "Ngye asàbwà an'köm kusà a Mwol, Nzam angye, ngye sye ayàsyääl nde mpɛl." »
Satanà kàfun'syen u Yɛlusàlɛm, kun'si udu a ndwà a Nzam, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Isàkal naa ngye awà Mwan a Nzam, tɔɔmà sɛmà pà tii u nsi, ntɔn bàsön naa:
"Nde ayàswaŋ in'kyeey ande ntɔn ngye, ntɔn ba batii,
anà ba sye bàsawal kan'kɔɔ aba ntɔn làkɔl angye làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abööl u nkɔŋ." »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Bàsön naa: "Ngye asun'kur anki Mwol, Nzam angye". »
Pa kàmay nde ndɛb yanswà, Satanà waa kàlwomà tsütsü apà Yɛsu tii utaaŋ asin.
Yɛsu kan'sɛmà isal ande u Ngalilɛ
Yɛsu kàkäl aŋàyɔl a ngwal a Dweelà mpal kàfurà nde Ngalilɛ. Làsaŋ ande làpää kà itiir a nsi aki kyanswà.
Nde kàyilɔŋà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Baar banswà bàkyer un'sà làkoo.
Yɛsu bàmutɔn u Nasàlɛr
Apan, Yɛsu kàkyen Nasàlɛr ikal kàyɛl nde. Asànaa ifà ande, nde kàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà ilä a saba. Nde kàmbarà ntɔn mutaŋ,
ba bun'pɛ un'kaan a ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay. Nde kàduub wa, waa kàmɛn ikal bàsön naa:

content.text: « Dweelà a Mwol là udu amɛ,
ntɔn nde kan'si an'kɔɔ ntɔn mukyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ akà aŋàlàmbwà,
nde kan'töm mukyään ntsuuŋà akà baar aŋàkwɛlà,
anà akà ikwàmii muman, mutsuuŋ baar bàŋàmɛɛy nkwaaŋ,
mukyään mbul usàswaŋ Mwol kab angway ande. »
Ungö apan nde kàdübà un'kaan awun, kàpɛ wa akà un'syääl, waa kàbwaay. Uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, mii myanswà myàkäl muler nde.
Apan nde kàsɛmà mutɛn a ba naa: « Itiir a Ndaa a Nzam an'taŋ mɛ yi, akà bɛ baar làweemà ya, ya yan'kwo ŋàbawà. »
Baar banswà bun'tɛɛlà imbäl: ba bàkäl mubem ntɔn ndaa aŋàbwaŋ iyatoo u mun ande, wɛɛ ba bàtɛɛnà naa: « Wà mà mwan a Yɔsɛfi! »
Apan Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mɛ inkyàyöb naa bɛ làyan'tɛɛl itim ki: "Ungaŋ, kɔɔr ngye ŋakwo, bɛ làyàtɛn naa kyer u bul angye asànaa kàkyer ngye u Kapɛrnawum."
Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ alàkyään ndandaa naa akà ŋangɔɔm mwɛy ufun'wal u nsi ande watɛy.
Mɛ alàkyään ndandaa, akweel adim bàkäl mbɔɔn u taaŋ a Ɛli kà Isàlɛl mpal mbul mpa kànɔ̈ wa mbul tär a ngɔn syaam. Ngyal yàkyer abilà u mɛɛn manswà,
wɛɛ Ɛli bun'töm anki akà umwɛy uboo a ba, bun'töm akà un'kweel un'dim mwɛy u Sarɛpta, u mɛɛn a Sidɔn.
Baar a ukyal a bay sye bàkäl mbɔɔn kà Isàlɛl utaaŋ a ŋangɔɔm Ɛlisya, ba banswà bàkɔɔrà anki, Naaman un'nsi Siri mpɛl. »

content: Baar banswà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà bàwem nkyɛl mbɔɔn mpal bàwem ba indiir abi byanswà.
Waa bàmbarà, bun'böŋ u bul aba, bun'syen udu a mɔŋ bàtöŋ bul aba ntɔn mukun'siinà waa nde ukàbwà u ngyɛl.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàlyaaŋ uboo aba, waa kàkyen.
Mbuur kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe
Apan Yɛsu kàtyà Kapɛrnawum, bul a Ngalilɛ. Nde kàlɔɔŋà ilä a saba.
Baar bàmɛn ndaa yubem ntɔn nde kàlɔɔŋà a ikɔ̈b.
U ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe. Mpal kàmɛn nde Yɛsu, nde kàsi in'kwɛŋ:
« Aa! Yɛsu un'nsi Nasàlɛr, ngye ininà akwen ntɔn bi? Ngye ayi ntɔn muböŋ bi? Mɛ in'kyàyöb naa ngye awà nà, ngye awà Ŋun'kyɛɛl a Nzam. »
Yɛsu waa kun'ŋän, waa kàtɛn naa: « Kal a duu, too uboo a mbuur wà. » Dweelà a làbe lun'bwiy u nsi, waa làtoo ukɔɔn akun'kyer ube.
Baar banswà bàkäl u bɔɔmà, waa bàtɛɛnà ba a ba naa: « Ndaa nà ayi? Nde wà mutɛɛnà a ngwal anà ikɔ̈b a an'dweelà an'be, ma sye màmutoo! »
Làsaŋ ande làpää kà itiir a nsi akin.
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr abɛy mbɔɔn
Yɛsu kàtoo u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa kàkyen ndwà a Simɔn. Ukwà a Simɔn kàkäl anà làbwey a mpye mbɔɔn. Ba bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n mukun'kɔɔr.
Yɛsu waa kànyee udu ande, waa kàböŋ ukyal aban. Umpal bàtoo ba u ndür ande, nde waa kàsubà, waa kàsɛmà mukasyääl.
U làbwàmpib, baar bàkäl anà baar a an'kyal mà ifà ifà batwäl akà Yɛsu. Nde kasi an'kɔɔ, ba waa bàkɔɔrà.
An'dweelà an'be sye màtoo anà in'kwɛŋ anà màtɛn naa: « Ngye awà Mwan a Nzam. » Wɛɛ Yɛsu katsüŋ a ngwal ntɔn ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n afàtɛn, ntɔn ba bàkyer ayöbà naa nde kàkäl Klistɔ.
An'lɔɔŋ a Yɛsu u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà
Taaŋtyà ututu, Yɛsu kàkyer atoo, waa kàkyen kikal a mpey. Baar mbɔɔn bàkyer ayun'leŋà. Mpal bun'mɛn ba, ba bàkwen mukun'tà mpi ntɔn nde ukɔɔn asawɛy.
Wɛɛ nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mɛ in'kyer akàpay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ là imwol a Nzam kà an'bul mumwɛy, ntɔn ndaa kan'töm Nzam yayi. »
Nde kàlɔɔŋà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà u Yuday.
